name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A framed list of sections that open and close, built on native <details> and <summary>. Each section has a title, optional meta text on the right and a chevron.
whenToUse: Several blocks of related content where the reader usually needs one or two at a time (results by metric, FAQ, settings groups). The accordion is the block's one container: put it straight in tx-main__body, or inside a tx-card where it sits flush. Use tabs instead when the sections are peers the reader switches between.

variants.description: The framed list. Children are tx-accordion__item <details> elements; add the open attribute to start a section expanded.
Short muted text on the right of a summary (a count, a date, a status).
No frame, for use inside a card body (applied automatically inside tx-card).

a11y: Native <details>/<summary> gives keyboard (Enter/Space) and screen-reader expanded state with no script. Put a heading element inside the summary title so the sections appear in the page outline. The chevron is decorative (aria-hidden).
